<thought>Execute a Python script via the Code_Executor that configures the Nanosurf AFM for a gentle tapping (Phase‑Contrast) mode, sets the scan size to 30 µm × 30 µm with 128 × 128 points, starts the scan, and then retrieves the absolute path of the saved topography image. The script will print the path so the tool returns it.</thought>
<action>Code_Executor</action>
<action_input>{"code":"import nanosurf, uuid, os, sys, traceback

try:
    # Initialise the instrument
    spm = nanosurf.SPM()  # works for C3000, CX, CoreAFM etc.
    app = spm.application
    scan = app.Scan
    opmode = app.OperatingMode
    head = app.ScanHead

    # ---- Set a gentle tapping (Phase‑Contrast) mode ----
    # PhaseContrast is the typical tapping mode for minimal tip wear
    opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.PhaseContrast
    # Choose a standard tapping cantilever (adjust if needed)
    head.CantileverByGUID = spm.CantileverGUID.Tap190Al_G

    # ---- Scan parameters ----
    scan.ImageWidth = 30e-6   # 30 µm
    scan.ImageHeight = 30e-6  # 30 µm
    scan.Points = 128         # points per line
    scan.Lines = 128          # lines per frame
    # centre the scan at the current tip position (0,0)
    scan.CenterPosX = 0.0
    scan.CenterPosY = 0.0

    # ---- File naming ----
    # Create a unique filename mask so we can locate the file later
    unique_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
    filename_mask = f"scan_{unique_id}_"
    app.SetGalleryHistoryFilenameMask(filename_mask)

    # ---- Start the scan ----
    # The API uses the Scan.Start() method; after completion the image is stored
    # in the gallery folder defined by the application settings.
    scan.Start()

    # ---- Retrieve the saved image path ----
    # The gallery history can be queried; the most recent entry is the image we just acquired.
    # The method GetGalleryHistory returns a list of file paths.
    gallery = app.GetGalleryHistory()
    if not gallery:
        print("No image files found after scan.")
        sys.exit(1)
    # The last entry should be our new image
    image_path = gallery[-1]
    print(image_path)
except Exception as e:
    traceback.print_exc()
    sys.exit(1)
"}
